# (APPENDIX) Appendix {-}

# About the project {#about}

## Contributing {-}

Feature suggestions, bug reports, support requests and offers to collaborate
are all welcome. Open an issue on the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/iep-ferreira/biomastats/issues) or write
to [iuri@ufscar.br](mailto:iuri@ufscar.br).

## Citing the data {-}

The land use and land cover maps come from the MapBiomas Project, Collection 10
of the Annual Series of Land Cover and Land Use Maps of Brazil (Souza et al.,
2020), available at <https://mapbiomas.org> under a CC BY-SA licence. The
sources of the external layers are listed in Chapter \@ref(data-sources).

## Use of artificial intelligence {-}

Artificial intelligence tools were used to support the preparation of this
material and of the package, under the team's supervision and review, for code
refactoring and optimisation, writing, and translation into English. All
content produced with this help was reviewed and validated by the authors, who
take full responsibility for the information presented.
